decisions: D-17 explicitly reclassifies borabora_tourist and borabora_boat_traffic from 'degraded' to 'unknown' because CoralSoundExplorer's own framing for these is a human-use/disturbance context, not a coral-condition assessment. Applying that same reasoning to the third Bora-Bora site, borabora_undisturbed, is Claude's discretion (not explicit in D-17): 'undisturbed' sounds like a health claim, but CoralSoundExplorer frames all three Bora-Bora recording points as one disturbance-gradient study (undisturbed / tourist / boat-traffic zones), not a MARRS-style coral-condition survey, so none of the three should carry a ReefRadar-invented health status. The owner can revert this one choice by deleting the 'borabora_undisturbed' entry from `sites` below; that site would then fall back to the CoralSoundExplorer source default (no status override, no label_original/label_definition), which still returns a true label_source/label_assigned_by via apply_label_provenance but leaves its original status untouched.

marrs.assigned_by: MARRS research team (Williams, Jones et al. 2025)

definitions.healthy: Least disturbed reef habitat in the local area.
definitions.degraded: Comparable to restored sites prior to restoration (rubble).
definitions.restored_early: Reef stars installed less than 3 months before recording.

sanctsound.assigned_by: NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries

borabora_undisturbed.label_definition: CoralSoundExplorer recording-point category describing a comparatively undisturbed use/disturbance context, not a coral-condition assessment.
borabora_undisturbed.status_basis: ReefRadar's discretion: part of a disturbance-gradient study (undisturbed/tourist/boat-traffic), not a MARRS-style health assessment. See top-level 'decisions'.

borabora_tourist.label_definition: CoralSoundExplorer use/disturbance context category (tourist-zone recording point), not a coral-condition assessment.
borabora_tourist.status_basis: Disturbance context (tourist activity), not a health assessment.

borabora_boat_traffic.label_definition: CoralSoundExplorer use/disturbance context category (boat-channel recording point), not a coral-condition assessment.
borabora_boat_traffic.status_basis: Disturbance context (boat traffic), not a health assessment.

irma_eastern_sambo.status_basis: Hurricane Irma Dataset (Simmons, Bohnenstiehl & Eggleston) assigns no health status to its recording sites upstream.

irma_western_dry_rocks.status_basis: Hurricane Irma Dataset (Simmons, Bohnenstiehl & Eggleston) assigns no health status to its recording sites upstream.
irma_western_dry_rocks.period: This site's embedding is built from recordings made in October 2017, after Hurricane Irma made landfall in the Florida Keys on 10 September 2017.

sanctsound_fk01.status_basis: NOAA SanctSound assigns no health status to its monitoring sites upstream.

sanctsound_fk03.status_basis: NOAA SanctSound assigns no health status to its monitoring sites upstream.
